data.name: PSYCHOTROPIK
data.detailed_description:
A New Apocalypse

Welcome to Zelar, the only remaining landmass on Earth, a fractured archipelago suspended between rebirth and collapse. Across tropical coastlines, bone-dry deserts, alpine forests, and snow-capped mountain ranges, a new civilization struggles to survive above the drowned remains of the old world.

Beneath the ocean’s surface, entire cities lie silent — entombed in water and memory.

PSYCHOTROPIK is an open-world post-apocalyptic RPG experience built around atmosphere, scale, and consequence — grounded in physical exploration, shaped by the places you go, the people you meet, and the choices you make.

A World of Contrast

Emerge from the ocean depths and explore the archipelago, from sun-soaked tropical beaches and dense rainforests to treacherous alpine forests and blizzardy mountain peaks. 

Dive below the drowned metropolis to explore the submerged ruins of the old world, where sunken structures hold secrets to the new and old world alike.

Align or annihilate the opposing factions vying for total control of what's left of the planet and its people.

Exploration & Choice

Engage in branching dialogue, undertake quests, and decide where your loyalties lie as hostile forces attempt to define humanity's ultimate fate.

Entangle yourself with one of the factions or destroy them all. Stay on earth or abandon it. 

There are no safe paths — only decisions and their consequences.

Grounded Combat, Your Way

Defend yourself any way you can, from rusted machetes and fire axes to corroded pistols, rifles, submachine guns and shotguns. Infiltrate outposts and fortresses stealthily using a bow and arrow and throwing knives, or wipe them out loudly with LMGs, grenades, and explosive arrows.

Experience the chaos in first or third person perspective, the choice is yours.

Features

  • Massive interconnected open world spanning radically distinct biomes

  • Fully traversable tropical islands, canyons, deserts, alpine forests, and snow-covered mountains

  • Fully explorable drowned ruins beneath the ocean

  • Quest-driven, lore-heavy role-playing and branching conversations

  • First-person and Third-person perspectives with enhanced Motion Matching technology

  • AAA quality shooting and gunplay

  • Visceral one and two-handed melee combat

  • Rich environmental storytelling through scale, decay, and atmosphere

  • Dynamic time and weather system including a full day/night cycle, seasons, rain and thunderstorms, lightning, snow and blizzards

  • 3D audio effects and a heart-pounding electronic soundtrack

data.short_description: Embark on an odyssey at the end of the world in PSYCHOTROPIK, the debut open-world RPG from Neon Beach Games. Reborn as a clone after a global flood, you emerge from the depths of a drowned planet, fighting to stay alive in search of a way out.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10
  • Processor: INTEL CORE I5-8400 or AMD RYZEN 3 3300X
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 3060 8GB or AMD Radeon RX 570 4GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Additional Notes: SSD (Preferred)
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10
  • Processor: INTEL CORE I7-8700K or AMD RYZEN 5 3600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 3080Ti or AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Additional Notes: SSD (Preferred)
